plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused full-body S&C session each week. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so percentage work can start cleanly in Week 2, then Weeks 2-4 build strength first, layer in simple explosive work, and finish with brief conditioning that supports boxing without stealing recovery from skill work.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish baseline strength in Week 1, then build general strength and simple power with controlled conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength lifts and keep power quality high while trimming unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward sharper, faster outputs while holding onto the strength built earlier.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low box and stick each landing. Reset between reps and keep every jump crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Jump for height and land softly if boxes are awkward or crowded.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with several small jumps in load, then take one hard but clean top set. Stop the set when bar speed slows or form breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3 to 5 reps. This establishes your baseline for the next block of percentage work.

substitutionOptions.name: Safety Bar Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if shoulder position or rack comfort makes the back squat awkward.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if barbell squatting is not yet safe or coachable.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Control the lowering, pause briefly at the bottom, then drive up hard. Leave 2 reps in reserve on each set.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Bench Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you have a good setup and a reliable spotter.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a simpler option with less setup.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Pull to the lower ribs with a short pause and keep the chest glued to the pad. Leave 1 to 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the chest-supported station is busy.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you need a simpler stable setup.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Soft knees, long spine, and stop where hamstrings are loaded without losing position. Leave 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if barbell setup is limited.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Keep ribs down and move slowly enough to stay braced. Shorten the range if your low back wants to arch.

substitutionOptions.name: Stability Ball Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the ab wheel is too difficult right now.

exercises.name: Air Bike Intervals
exercises.notes: Push hard but smooth. Keep pace repeatable across rounds.

endurancePrescription.format: 8 rounds of 15 seconds hard, 45 seconds easy
endurancePrescription.intensity: Hard on work bouts, easy full recovery pace between bouts
